attchmntText: MM Forgings Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: MM Forgings Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 post-results conference call held on 13 November 2026. The unaudited financial results were approved by the Board on 5 November 2026. For H1 FY27, the company reported a turnover of INR 978 crores and sales of 44,000 tons. Q2 sales stood at INR 551 crores with an EBITDA of INR 110 crores. The company merged DVS Industries and recorded a land sale profit of INR 54 crores. Management expects H2 sales of 50,000 tons, targeting a full-year turnover of INR 2,000 crores. For FY28, the company projects sales exceeding 100,000 tons and a turnover of INR 2,400 to INR 2,500 crores. Current capacity is 130,000 tons. A new heavy press is scheduled for commissioning in Q4 FY27.

attchmntText: MM Forgings Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: M M Forgings Limited filed a performance update presentation for Q2 and H1 FY27 with the BSE and NSE. Standalone revenue for Q2 FY27 rose 42% to Rs. 551 crore. EBITDA increased 53% to Rs. 111 crore. Profit before tax grew 139% to Rs. 65 crore. Profit after tax rose 134% to Rs. 19 crore. Earnings per share increased to Rs. 3.9. For H1 FY27, standalone revenue grew 29% to Rs. 978 crore. EBITDA rose 34% to Rs. 193 crore. Profit before tax increased 200% to Rs. 165 crore. Profit after tax surged 262% to Rs. 137 crore. This H1 PAT includes Rs. 56 crore net of tax profit from the sale of land near Oragadam. Earnings per share for H1 FY27 reached Rs. 28.47. Domestic sales accounted for 67% of Q2 revenue. Export sales made up 33%. Commercial vehicles represented 78% of sales.

attchmntText: MM Forgings Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: M M Forgings Limited has filed the audio recording of the Analyst and Investors conference call held on 13 November 2026. The call discussed unaudited Financial Results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. These results were approved in a Board Meeting held on 05 November 2026. The company requests the Bombay Stock Exchange and National Stock Exchange of India Ltd to take the recording on record. The filing is made under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The security codes for the exchanges are 522241 for BSE and MMFL for NSE. The document was signed by S. Muthukrishnan, Company Secretary.
